summary: FG Communities Holdings filed an 8-K (Items 7.01, 8.01, 9.01) reporting two closed manufactured-housing community acquisitions. On October 8, 2026, it closed the purchase of a 59-acre, 49-homesite community at 5004 Lee Drive, Garner, North Carolina; on October 9, 2026, it closed a 19-acre, 29-homesite community at 205 Big Brown Rd, Mars Hill, North Carolina. Both sellers were unaffiliated third parties and consideration was cash on hand. No price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation was disclosed. Smaller add-on tuck-ins; watch for financing capacity, integration, and future pipeline disclosures.
